scope_boundary: F3 family source research only; no shared runtime, registry, ledger, or active native attempt is changed

blockers.evidence: run_request() constructs output=data_root/families/attempt and publishes its receipt there
blockers.impact: A solver argv path pointing into /tmp would be outside the runtime output tree.

blockers.evidence: headroom, live free-floor, tree_bytes, and receipt bytes inspect data_root or the Home attempt output
blockers.impact: Raw native bytes in /tmp would evade reserved-storage accounting, Home free-floor monitoring, and receipt byte totals.

blockers.evidence: the current launcher waits for one child process and assigns completed/failed from proc.returncode before publishing the receipt
blockers.impact: A solver-plus-archive wrapper would make archive exit indistinguishable from native solver exit.

blockers.evidence: CPU_KINDS contains conversion/audit/etc. but no native_archive task, and no post-native archive hook exists
blockers.impact: A separate CPU archive cannot be reserved, accounted, or linked to the native receipt by the current runtime.

blockers.evidence: the user window allows up to eight solver leases while current check_reservation caps active qualification/production reservations at four
blockers.impact: An eight-solver staging policy cannot be claimed without a reviewed runtime/ledger change.

required_runtime_extension_before_enable.scope: shared runtime change required; this package does not implement it
guard_requirements: Reserve both Home and NVMe capacities before launch under the same ledger lock.
Check Home free >= 536870912000 and NVMe free >= stage_limit + 107374182400 before launch and during the native process.
Count every staged byte against the native reservation, including stdout, Run.out, BI4-derived solver output, and all data frames.
Keep the official DualSPHysics executable as the direct child; preserve argv, cwd, XML/BI4, DP, physical controls, tmax, tout, and saved-frame recipe exactly.
Write a native receipt only after proc.wait(); native_status/native_returncode must reflect the official solver process alone.
Release the GPU lease only after the official native child has exited and its native receipt is atomically published.
Create the CPU archive reservation only from a completed native receipt and a frozen staged-file manifest.
native_stage_publication: For every staged file, record source path, size, mode, mtime_ns, and SHA256 without mutating the source.
Before copying, capture source stat; stream-copy to a same-filesystem temporary file; fsync; verify digest and source stat after the copy.
Publish the staged manifest atomically only after every required native artifact passes verification.
On any failure, preserve the partial manifest/proof and original source; never publish a completed native or archive receipt.
cpu_archive: Run as a separate CPU request using the existing conversion/audit resource accounting only after the native receipt is completed.
Keep archive_status/archive_returncode in a separate archive receipt; never overwrite native status or native_returncode.
Copy from /tmp to the canonical Home attempt path with the same stat-before/after and digest-before-publish protocol.
Publish an archive-complete marker only after all required BI4/log/data files match the staged manifest.
A failed archive leaves the native completed receipt authoritative but blocks downstream typed conversion and visual review.

minimal_root_diagnostic.required_root_decision: either land and review the shared runtime extension above, or keep native output on the existing Home attempt root
